recall.question: Two bins share a cupboard 5 deep: one you open 4 times a season, one once. With the frequent bin at the back, how many removals is that over the season, against having it at the front?
recall.why: At the back, each of the 4 uses moves 4 blockers: 16. At the front, only the once-a-season request pays the 4: total 4. Count access cost across uses, not one retrieval. The frequencies are examples.
